title: Two-sided comparison in [0, ∞] from (1 ± ε)-sandwiches (supplied step 10)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and t, ε, c ∈ ℝ with ε < 1, c ≥ 0, (1 + ε)^m ≤ t·(1 − ε) and 1 + ε ≤ t·(1 − ε)^m. Let X, H, I ∈ [0, ∞] satisfy ofReal((1 − ε)^m)·(ofReal(c)·X) ≤ H, H ≤ ofReal((1 + ε)^m)·(ofReal(c)·X), ofReal((1 − ε)·c)·X ≤ I and I ≤ ofReal((1 + ε)·c)·X, where ofReal = ENNReal.ofReal : ℝ → [0, ∞] (ofReal(x) = max(x, 0)) and products are taken in [0, ∞] (with 0·∞ = 0). Then H ≤ ofReal(t)·I and I ≤ ofReal(t)·H.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (t ε c : ℝ) (X H I : ℝ≥0∞), ε < 1 → 0 ≤ c → (1 + ε) ^ m ≤ t * (1 - ε) → 1 + ε ≤ t * (1 - ε) ^ m → ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε) ^ m) * (ENNReal.ofReal c * X) ≤ H → H ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) ^ m) * (ENNReal.ofReal c * X) → ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε) * c) * X ≤ I → I ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) * c) * X → H ≤ ENNReal.ofReal t * I ∧ I ≤ ENNReal.ofReal t * H
